run_transforms_test: run the unittest TransformsTest suite to test native and open3d PCD transform functionality
test_native_pcd_transform: test the TransformsTest.test_native_pcd_transform method that computes point clouds from RGB depth and camera transforms
load_intrinsic: create a function that loads camera intrinsic matrix and resolution from a JSON file
load_ground_truth_pcd: create a function that loads RGB image, depth map, base pose, and camera transform from test asset files
review_transforms_test: review the TransformsTest class and its test_native_pcd_transform method for point cloud transform correctness
